license.attribution_text: Service Equivalence Baseline by lqqk7 / EVERY SENSE JING-ZHANG (open-city-ai/haidian Issue #2549)
license.scope_note_zh: 许可仅覆盖基准条文与 schema(字段结构、枚举、语义与判定规则文本);本提交包的叙事、图面、几何与数据不在此许可内,另有各自来源登记与授权。
license.scope_note_en: The licence covers only the baseline text and schema (field structure, enumerations, semantics and adjudication-rule text); this package's narrative, figures, geometry and data are not covered and carry their own source registrations.

adoption_scope_zh: 组件级采纳:仅采纳 SEB 节点 schema 组件(五项必填字段及其 constraint_machine_rule 机器判据),用于 K标十驿 K0-K9 十处公共节点的 AI 关闭后等价路径声明。不认领任何 SEB 开放等级(L0-L4),不采用评分口径、等级定义、判定规则、AI 权限边界与双联交接台账五个组件。本包七项 SEB 包容性指标无实测数据,在 metrics.json 中保持 unknown。
adoption_scope_en: Component-level adoption: adopts only the SEB node_schema component (five required fields and their constraint_machine_rule machine criteria) to declare the AI-off equivalent route at the ten K-marker public nodes K0-K9. Claims no SEB open level (L0-L4) and adopts none of the other five components (scoring calibres, level definitions, adjudication rules, AI authority boundary, dual-copy handover ledger). This package has no measured data for the seven SEB inclusivity indicators; they remain unknown in metrics.json.
adopter_lexicon_note_zh: 本采用未声明 adopter_lexicon:全部 human_handoff 取值均命中 SEB 规范本体的 13 项角色词表,无需本地化扩充。
adopter_lexicon_note_en: No adopter_lexicon is declared: every human_handoff value hits the spec's own 13-token role list, so no localisation extension is required.
node_design_note_zh: 十处节点的 ai_off_path 逐点不同,不使用统一模板:等价路径必须由该节点的实际空间条件决定(碑刻、展板、门岗、公告栏、纸本、实体导视各有适用处),统一填写同一句话等于没有逐点设计。
node_design_note_en: The ten ai_off_path values differ node by node rather than repeating one template: an equivalent route has to follow the actual spatial conditions of that node (inscriptions, boards, gate posts, notice walls, printed matter and physical wayfinding each apply in different places). One sentence repeated ten times would mean no per-node design at all.

self_check.note_zh: 本自检只复算 SEB 节点 schema 的机器判据(禁用词命中、角色词命中、枚举合法、字段齐备),不产生任何等级、评分或绩效结论。
self_check.note_en: This self-check recomputes only the node_schema machine criteria (forbidden-token hits, role-token hits, enum validity, field presence). It yields no level, score or performance conclusion.

boundary_zh: 全部节点 gate_id 均为 G0、operating_mode 均为 concept_design_not_operating:本方案没有任何一处节点在运行,以上等价路径是概念设计承诺而非既有服务。判据自洽不等于现场有效;不代表机构采纳、批准、现场验证或官方背书。
boundary_en: Every node is at gate_id G0 with operating_mode concept_design_not_operating: no node in this proposal is operating, and the routes above are design commitments rather than existing services. Self-consistent criteria are not field effectiveness; nothing here implies institutional adoption, approval, field verification or official endorsement.
reciprocity_note_zh: 登记互采:SEB v0.2 发布文本在机制谱系中署名折返协议(Issue #1119)为其体裁与开放方式的来源先例;本文件是反向的组件级采用。两个方向均为自愿采用登记,不构成任何一方对另一方的背书。
reciprocity_note_en: Mutual adoption, registered: the SEB v0.2 release text credits the Switchback Protocol (Issue #1119) as the precedent for its format and mode of opening; this file is the component-level adoption in the reverse direction. Both directions are voluntary adoption registrations and neither constitutes an endorsement of one party by the other.
